summary: MDJM LTD filed a Form 6-K announcing the adoption of its 2026 Second Equity Incentive Plan and the grant of 400,000 restricted shares (200,000 Class A and 200,000 Class B ordinary shares) to employees, including 200,000 Class B shares to CEO Siping Xu. The plan reserves up to 200,000 Class A and 200,000 Class B shares for future awards. Post-grant, the CEO controls ~89.71% of voting power. This is a routine equity compensation filing, not a special situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, or restructuring is involved. The filing serves only to register and disclose an executive compensation arrangement.
